manifest.name: @l-vm2k/dsh-ayaka-theme
manifest.description: Kamisato Ayaka ice-bloom theme + desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness Web Client

bundle.text:
# Kamisato Ayaka ice-bloom theme + desktop pet — bundle patch layer.
#
# This file is what makes this package a DSH *bundle*: `dsh plugin --profile web
# add` detects the `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration in package.json and appends
# this layer to the profile's bundle stack. On `dsh web` startup the launcher
# composes every bundle's patch list in order, then the user's own
# cordis.patch.yml, producing the final entry tree the Loader mounts.
#
# One row is contributed:
#   - id: ui-ayaka-theme — loads @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-ayaka-theme.
#     The node-half apply() registers the /ayaka-assets prefix route on the
#     webServer (serving bundled images + audio so the plugin is
#     self-contained — no dependency on the frontend dist's public/). The
#     browser half is resolved by the modules scanner from the package's
#     dsh.client declaration and served at /plugins/<name>/client.js; it
#     registers the ayaka-light / ayaka-dark themes through the ThemeRuntime
#     and spawns the portrait, pet, and falling sakura petals.
#
# A single entry is correct: the Loader mounts the package's node-half once
# (registering the route once), and the modules scanner picks up the browser
# half from dsh.client without a second insert. Two inserts of the same package
# name would load the node-half twice and register /ayaka-assets twice, which
# the webserver rejects as a duplicate prefix route.

- insert:
    - id: ui-ayaka-theme
      name: '@l-vm2k/dsh-ayaka-theme'

readme.text:
[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/your-owner/your-plugin-slug)

> 神里绫华 · 冰华主题 + 桌面宠物 — DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端主题插件

一个 DSH 标准 bundle 插件，安装后浏览器自动加载：

- 🌸 半透明绫华立绘贴在屏幕右侧
- 🐱 Q 版绫华小头趴在聊天输入框右上角，点击说话（语音 + 文字气泡同步）
- ❄️ 樱花花瓣 + 雪花飘落（混合大小，稀疏密度）
- 🎨 冰蓝色主题配色（亮色/暗色双模式）

---

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:l-vm2k/dsh-ayaka-theme
```

然后重启 dsh web：

```bash
dsh --profile web
```

打开浏览器，绫华主题已加载 （记得必须是深色主题！！！！否则将会变白花花的一片）✨

```
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 层：一行 insert 挂载插件
├── tsconfig.json         # TS 配置
├── tsdown.config.ts      # 构建配置

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-ayaka-theme
      name: '@l-vm2k/dsh-ayaka-theme'
```

**一行 insert 同时触发两件事**：
1. Loader 挂载 node 半 → `apply()` 注册 `/ayaka-assets` 路由
2. modules 扫描器自动发现 `dsh.client` → 服务浏览器 bundle

> ⚠️ 不要写两行 insert 指向同一个包，会导致 node 半执行两次，重复注册路由报错。

---

pnpm run build      # tsc → lib/types/ + tsdown → lib/index.js + lib/client.js
```
